title: Clowns
build: 8 KB Ultimax cartridge (CRT name "Clowns", hardware type 0, EXROM 1, GAME 0, ROM at $E000-$FFFF); ROM SHA-1 ffebfc19263dc50d3a808135dbe88567617af6b8

tools.emulator: own build of github.com/barryw/vice-mcp, release v3.13.2, commit 1e83aab134 (VICE x64sc, PAL)
tools.host: Windows 11 Pro with WSL2, Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS

exclude: runtime: the RAM the game uses (zero page, the stack, the globals and software stack at $0200-$03FF, sprite 0's shape at $03C0 and the screen at $0400), all written by the cartridge's own code; nothing of the game is loaded there

not the game's: no instruction of the cartridge reads or writes $0800-$CFFF except the operands of five BIT instructions used to skip a byte and an unreachable JMP $7000, and $D000-$DFFF is the I/O chips
